subject: Renewal / Expansion: compact demo slot swaps + capture consent
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal / Expansion: compact demo slot swaps + capture consent

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, the roadmap QBR for Veridian will need to balance exec availability (short windows) and a hands-on demo for your platform team. Two small asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether Tom (security lead) needs the full technical walkthrough or just the top-level architecture and latency/cost numbers?
2) We want to capture the session for internal ops training — can you confirm recording consent from your side and whether any redaction is needed?

Proposed approach: run a 45-min compact demo + 30-min roadmap discussion (75 mins total). Below are three candidate time windows next week (Pacific):
- Option A: Tue 9/21 10:00–11:15 PT
- Option B: Wed 9/22 08:30–09:45 PT
- Option C: Thu 9/23 15:00–16:15 PT

I've attached a condensed agenda and a preliminary attendee list; feel free to update the CSV with final attendees. If none of these work, tell me which half-day you prefer and we will slice into two 40-min blocks.

Thanks — looking to lock this in so we can reserve an engineer and the exec slot.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior AE, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v3.pdf (agenda), Veridian_attendee_list.csv (editable)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal / Expansion: compact demo slot swaps + capture consent

Marissa —

Appreciate the concrete options. Quick answers:
- Tom wants the technical walkthrough but only needs deep-dive on inference security, data residency, and audit logging. He will skip the full architecture unless we hit questions.
- Recording is fine for internal training. We cannot include patient data in any recording, and we ask that you blur any demo screens that surface PHI.

Regarding times: Option A conflicts with our exec backlog. Option B works best for Tom and our infra lead (we prefer mornings). Could we do Wed 9/22 08:30–09:45 PT as planned? If possible, can you move the hands-on notebook up to the first 30 minutes, then roadmap afterward? That helps our engineers who need to jump to follow-up work.

I'll update the attendee CSV with final names later today.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
Veridian Health
elena.ruiz@veridianhealth.com

--- Forwarded message attached: attendee CSV updated to show Tom + 3 engineers
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal / Expansion: compact demo slot swaps + capture consent

Marissa / Karthik —

I see Elena selected Wed 9/22 08:30–09:45 PT and asked to run the hands-on notebook first. Quick ops notes:

- I'll reserve two engineer seats (Karthik, me) and set up a compact Jupyter notebook with sample data that avoids PHI. We will use a local synthetic dataset and a redaction overlay for any UI screenshots.
- Recording: we can host on our internal S3 with access controls; ask Veridian to sign the recording consent link (DocuSign) so Legal has a record. I can forward the DocuSign link once Marissa approves.
- Tech checklist: GPU pool pinned to quantized LLM variant, KV cache disabled for the demo, and a short slide with SLOs and retention policy (2 months) ready to share.

Marissa — can you confirm the DocuSign request and if we should include a short one-paragraph release that Veridian signs? I can draft it. Also, do we want to invite a solutions engineer to the first 15 minutes to handle setup?

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal / Expansion: compact demo slot swaps + capture consent

Elena / Tom —

Perfect — Wed 9/22 08:30–09:45 PT is confirmed on our side. Plan below:

08:30–08:45 PT: Quick exec check-in + consent confirmation (Marissa, Elena, Tom)
08:45–09:15 PT: Hands-on notebook demo (Priyom + Karthik) — synthetic data, no PHI
09:15–09:35 PT: Roadmap discussion (Hannah) + open Q&A on SLAs/costs
09:35–09:45 PT: Next steps & action items (Marissa)

Action items assigned:
- Elena: final attendee list (Veridian_attendee_list.csv) — please add any last-minute guests by EOD Monday 9/20
- Tom: confirm whether he wants the short SLO slide pre-shared (yes/no)
- Priyom: draft DocuSign recording consent paragraph and share for legal review by 9/16
- Karthik/Hannah: create the 2-slide SLO + retention summary and a one-page cost primer by 9/20

I'll send the calendar invite with a Teams link and the agenda attached. Recording consent DocuSign link will be included in the invite notes once Priyom shares it. Let me know if we should shift the order or extend by 15 minutes.

—Marissa
